mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates accelerating consumer demand that drives corporate revenue expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production above 110.0 signals early expansion phase economic momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 110.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 2000.0 thousand units indicate robust housing market activity that stimulates construction spending and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 2000.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Continuously rising employment (PAYEMS) indicates sustained labor market strength that increases household income and consumption, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales above 360000.0 million dollars indicates elevated consumer spending that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 360000.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 5.0%) and low CPI (CPIAUCSL < 202.0) indicate stable monetary conditions that reduce equity risk premiums, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both conditions hold, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.
